name: Willow You Be Mine?
source:
You are the largest willow tree in the swamp. Sadly, you find yourself lonely, never feeling any connection with those who would seek sanctuary among your leaves. But you haven't lost hope. Surely you'll meet someone you connect with. As luck would have it, someone is approaching!

Who could it be? A timid orchid? A fierce wasp? A polite spider? Perhaps you could form a kinship with them... or perhaps something more? 

[From [url=https://justplayfly.itch.io/wybm]itch.io[/url]]
